exposure: intake of anticonvulsant drugs during pregnancy
cohort: 420 newborn-mother pairs admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit in Hiwot Fana Specialized University Hospital, Harar, Ethiopia
finding: Preterm birth, low birth weight, maternal coffee consumption, history of abortion or stillbirth, radiation exposure, and intake of anticonvulsant drugs during pregnancy were associated with neural tube defects.
gest_age: Preterm (32-34 weeks) mentioned as a risk factor, but overall gestational age of cohort not specified.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (1000-1500g and 1500-2500g) mentioned as risk factors, but overall birth weight range of cohort not specified
